card.text: Explore Prometheus with Cassini imagery, mapped radial height and its measured irregular shape.

introduction.text: Prometheus is an elongated icy moon moving just inside Saturn’s F ring. Its gravity draws channels and streamers out of the ring. Cassini revealed craters and a soft-looking surface on this small, porous body.

normal.title: ISS mosaic
normal.summary: Brightness matching reduces photographed shading. The gray grid marks missing coverage and terrain hidden in cast shadows.

elevation.title: Shape-derived radial height
elevation.summary: Height relative to a 43.1 km sphere, from the Cassini shape model. Small craters are unresolved.
